items.statement: On a memory replay of the synthetic ownership loop, iteration-8 DreamGraph accuracy exceeds the 1-hop first-edge ablation by at least 0.10.
On the published HydraDB run, DreamGraph's final 3-hop answer rate exceeds the unweighted walk by at least 0.50.
The dict learner matches published DreamGraph accuracy on every iteration, absolute difference under 0.005.
On the vulnerability slice, the Spearman correlation between mean final learned cost and feed error rate is greater than 0.2.
On the vulnerability slice, the dict learner matches DreamGraph on every iteration, absolute difference under 0.005.
On the vulnerability slice, DreamGraph's final held-out accuracy exceeds majority vote by at least 0.02.
In the poisoned-source scenario the guard rolls back at least 3 policy versions, and the naive no-guard learner finishes at least 0.10 below DreamGraph.
Every poison rollback receipt has reason 'guard accuracy fell', a lower guard accuracy after the proposal than before, and strictly positive costs.

A model frozen after iteration 3 finishes within 0.08 of DreamGraph on the poison run, because the poison starts at iteration 4. The guard's evidence is the receipt log, not a unique final score against that frozen model.
When training reviews call NVD wrong and the bad NVD mirror right, the guard rolls back at least 3 versions and the naive learner finishes at least 0.05 below DreamGraph.
Every vulnerability-poison rollback receipt has reason 'guard accuracy fell', a lower guard accuracy after the proposal, and strictly positive costs.
On the vulnerability poison run, a model frozen after iteration 3 finishes within 0.08 of DreamGraph, because the poison starts at iteration 4.

On the vulnerability slice, DreamGraph — feed×project shrinkage costs, algo.SSpaths with pathCount and resultLimit both 5, and a trust-weighted vote of the returned paths within 0.15 of the cheapest — exceeds NVD-only final held-out accuracy by at least 0.01.
On the vulnerability slice, restricting that vote to paths within 0.15 of the cheapest exceeds an unrestricted top-5 vote of the same conditional costs by at least 0.01.
On the vulnerability slice, the cheapest path under feed×project costs exceeds the cheapest path under the same policy's per-feed costs by at least 0.01.

On the vulnerability poison run, the guard rolls back at least once on every seed, including seed 2. Reviews stay as logged, and a proposal must not degrade the reviews collected before the poison iteration.
